bottom_line: PLA military exercises near Taiwan increase shipping insurance costs and supply chain risk for semiconductor-dependent industries.
what_changed: PLA announced large-scale military exercises in waters surrounding Taiwan, including live-fire drills in designated exclusion zones overlapping commercial shipping lanes.
why_it_matters: Taiwan Strait handles ~50% of global container traffic; exclusion zones disrupt shipping schedules and raise war-risk premiums.
main_uncertainty: Exercise duration and whether exclusion zones will be enforced against commercial vessels remain unclear.

scenarios.name: Short exercise, no escalation
scenarios.description: Exercises end within announced period; shipping resumes normally.

scenarios.name: Extended presence
scenarios.description: PLA maintains naval presence beyond announced dates; shipping reroutes.

watch_next: War-risk premium changes from Lloyd's JWC
